note: Resolved per-room sensors, the floor/household and power aggregates derived from them, and the climate health-risk binary sensor. Reference only; entity ids are anonymised. Every aggregate reads the RESOLVED per-room sensor, never a device probe. Since v5.6 a calibration offset inside its helper's range is ALWAYS honoured: the range is the plausibility envelope, and an extra check could only reject a correct large offset and under-correct the room. Only the TRV offset, whose range is far wider than any bias physically possible on a cold radiator, is still substituted.

options.name: Climate health risk
options.state: {% set ns = namespace(risk=false) %}{% for r in ['living_room','office','bedroom','kid1','kid2'] %}{% set t = states('sensor.climate_temp_' ~ r) | float(-99) %}{% set h = states('sensor.climate_humidity_' ~ r) | float(-1) %}{% if t > -90 and h >= 0 %}{% if h >= 65 or h < 30 or t < 16 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{% set g = (17.27 * t / (237.7 + t)) + log(h / 100) %}{% set dp = 237.7 * g / (17.27 - g) %}{% if (t - dp) < 3 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if states('sensor.outside_openweathermap_air_quality_index') | int(0) >= 4 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{{ ns.risk }}
